requirements.statement: The CLI accepts opencode as an install target, includes it in --target all, and leaves it out of the bare default install.

verification.evidence: A temp-home CLI run with --target opencode printed [opencode] Installed lines; the bare default run printed only [claude] and created no OpenCode config home; a --target all run printed [opencode] lines.

requirements.statement: The opencode target dispatches through the shared skills-and-agents harness installer with an explicit opencodeHome override.

evidence.symbol: installSkillAndAgentHarness({ target: 'opencode', home: opencodeHome, skills, agents, replace })

verification.evidence: The dispatch branch passes opencodeHome to installSkillAndAgentHarness; the temp-home run installed three skill folders and six agent files, the same contract Codex and Cursor use.

requirements.statement: OpenCode artifacts are installed only as drop-in directories under the config home: skills/ and agents/.

verification.evidence: The temp-home install produced config/skills/{app-slop-audit,carapace,execution-plan-integrity} and config/agents/{six carapace-*.md files} and no other roots.

requirements.statement: No opencode.json or opencode.jsonc is created or edited by the install.

verification.evidence: After the temp-home install, neither CONFIG/opencode.json nor CONFIG/opencode.jsonc existed (both test -e checks returned false).

requirements.statement: The OpenCode config home resolves from OPENCODE_CONFIG_HOME, then XDG_CONFIG_HOME, then ~/.config/opencode.

verification.evidence: defaultOpenCodeHome is called as the opencodeHome default in install(); the CLI test pins OPENCODE_CONFIG_HOME to a temp root so --target all cannot write to the real config home.

integration.consumer: scripts/install.mjs#installSkillAndAgentHarness({ target: 'opencode', home: opencodeHome, skills, agents, replace })

falsification.assertion: An unknown target is rejected, so opencode is an explicit target rather than an accepted arbitrary string.
falsification.evidence: scripts/install.test.mjs asserts commandPlan(['--target', 'vscode']) throws the USAGE error; the focused suite passed with that assertion still present.

falsification.assertion: A locally modified installed skill is refused and the checkout copy stays byte-identical.
falsification.evidence: In the temp home, editing config/skills/carapace/SKILL.md made the next --target opencode run fail with 'differs from this checkout'; cmp against the pre-run copy of skills/carapace/SKILL.md confirmed the checkout file was unchanged; --replace then restored it.

falsification.assertion: The bare default install does not create an OpenCode config home.
falsification.evidence: The temp-home CLI run with OPENCODE_CONFIG_HOME set created no such directory; scripts/install.test.mjs asserts existsSync(env.OPENCODE_CONFIG_HOME) is false and passed.
